name: Generate code for visual graphics and animations
description: Users asked for code or instructions to generate visual outputs, such as images, geometric shapes, diagrams, and animations, by manipulating data structures, file formats, or programming libraries. The requests covered a wide variety of mediums, including ASCII art, PNG/JPEG files, vector graphics (SVG, PDF, DXF), and abstract computational visualizations like matrices, graph displays, and 3D models.
